de.subject: Heating maintenance on December 3
body: Dear tenants,
On Wednesday, December 3, the heating system will be serviced between 8 a.m. and 12 noon. There will be no hot water during this time.
Please make sure the boiler room is accessible. Thank you for your understanding.

Kind regards
Your property management
de.note: German emails are often formal, using Sie and set phrases such as "Mit freundlichen Grüßen" (kind regards). Letters from landlords, authorities and insurers tend to use long compound words, which Apple's translation splits into readable English.

fr.subject: Delivery delay for your order no. 4812
body: Hello,
We would like to let you know that your order no. 4812 will ship one week late, due to a stock shortage at our supplier.
We apologize for this inconvenience. Feel free to contact us if you would like to change or cancel your order.

Best regards,
The Atelier Lumière team
fr.note: French business emails favour polite formulas such as "Nous vous prions de" and "Cordialement". Mailkin keeps the meaning while turning them into the plain phrasing you'd expect in your language.

es.subject: Confirmation of your booking
body: Dear guest,
We confirm your booking of a double room from March 14 to 17. Check-in is from 3 p.m. and check-out is before 11 a.m.
If you need a transfer from the airport, reply to this email and we will arrange it.

Kind regards,
Reception
es.note: Spanish emails come from Spain and much of Latin America, with small differences in vocabulary. Apple's translation handles both, so a booking from Madrid and an invoice from Mexico City read equally well.

it.subject: Documents for your tax return
body: Dear client,
To prepare your tax return we need the receipts for medical expenses and the rental contract by April 30.
You can send us the documents by replying to this email or upload them to your private area.

Best regards,
Studio Rinaldi
it.note: Italian emails from offices, schools and public bodies use the formal Lei and phrases such as "Gentile cliente" and "Cordiali saluti". Mailkin translates the whole message, including subject lines and dates.

ja.subject: Scheduling a meeting
body: Thank you as always for your support.
Could we have some of your time next week for a meeting about the new product? Please let us know a time that suits you on Tuesday or Thursday afternoon.
I know you are busy, and I appreciate your help.
Tanaka
ja.note: Japanese business emails open and close with set courtesy phrases such as お世話になっております and よろしくお願いいたします. Apple's translation turns them into natural greetings rather than word-for-word text, so the actual request stands out.

zh.subject: Reply regarding your quotation request
body: Hello,
Thank you for your enquiry. The unit price for 5,000 pieces is US$2.35 each, including packaging, with delivery 25 days after the order is confirmed.
If you need samples, we can send them within three working days. We look forward to working with you.

Best regards,
Manager Li
zh.note: Mailkin translates Chinese emails written in simplified or traditional characters, common with suppliers, factories and partners in mainland China, Taiwan and Hong Kong. Prices, quantities and dates come through unchanged.

pt.subject: Feedback on the first version of the website
body: Hi, how are you?
We reviewed the first version of the website and really like the layout. We'd just ask you to change the photos on the home page and make the contact form shorter.
Could we get the new version by Friday?

All the best,
Mariana
pt.note: Portuguese emails from Brazil and from Portugal differ in tone and vocabulary. Brazilian emails are often informal, opening with "Olá, tudo bem?", while emails from Portugal tend to be more formal. Mailkin translates both.

ru.subject: Confirmation of your conference participation
body: Hello,
Thank you for registering for the TechnoForum conference, which takes place on April 22–23. Your talk has been included in the programme for the second day.
Please confirm your participation by April 1 by replying to this email.

Kind regards,
The organising committee
ru.note: Mailkin reads Russian emails in Cyrillic script and detects them automatically, even when the subject line is in English. Formal closings such as "С уважением" (respectfully) become the usual sign-off in your language.

ko.subject: Your order has been shipped
body: Hello,
The item you ordered (order no. 20481) was shipped today. International delivery usually takes about 7–10 days and may be delayed at customs.
You can track the delivery with the tracking number below. If you have any questions, just reply to this email.

Thank you.
Haneul Store
ko.note: Korean emails use polite endings such as 습니다 and 주세요, and often sign off with 드림 ("from"). Mailkin turns them into the usual polite phrasing in your language, so order updates and business emails from Korea read naturally.

ar.subject: Apartment viewing appointment
body: Hello,
We would like to confirm the apartment viewing next Sunday at 4 p.m. Our representative will be waiting for you at the building entrance.
Please bring a copy of your ID if you would like to sign the reservation contract on the same day.

Best regards,
Sales department
ar.note: Arabic is written right to left. Mailkin translates the text while Mail keeps the email's layout, so the result reads left to right in your language. Greetings such as "السلام عليكم" become an ordinary hello.

nl.subject: Confirmation of your appointment
body: Dear Sir or Madam,
We hereby confirm your appointment to apply for a passport on Tuesday, December 9 at 10:30 a.m. at the city office.
Bring your current passport and a recent passport photo. Can't make it? Change or cancel your appointment using the link in this email.

Kind regards,
Civil Affairs team
nl.note: Dutch emails from municipalities, landlords and schools are often formal ("Geachte heer/mevrouw") but direct. Mailkin translates the whole message, including times written as 10.30 uur and Dutch date formats.

pl.subject: Quote for the bathroom renovation
body: Hello,
Please find attached the quote for the bathroom renovation. The labour cost is PLN 9,800, and materials will be charged separately according to the invoices.
We can start work on January 12. Please confirm the date by the end of the week.

Kind regards,
Tomasz Nowak
pl.note: Polish emails often start with "Dzień dobry" and use the formal Pan/Pani. Amounts in złoty and dates come through clearly, which helps with quotes, invoices and messages from contractors.

tr.subject: About the shipment of your order
body: Hello,
Your order of 1,200 cotton T-shirts is ready and will leave the port of İzmir this Friday.
We will send the bill of lading and invoice details separately after shipment. Please let us know if anything changes.

Best regards,
Foreign Trade Department
tr.note: Turkish business emails from suppliers and logistics partners use set phrases such as "Saygılarımızla" (respectfully). Mailkin keeps quantities, ports and dates intact, which matters most in trade emails.

uk.subject: Parents' meeting on Thursday
body: Good afternoon, dear parents,
We invite you to the parents' meeting on Thursday at 6 p.m. in room 214. We will discuss the school trip and the holiday schedule.
If you can't come, please let the class teacher know in advance.

Kind regards,
Parents' committee
uk.note: Mailkin detects Ukrainian separately from Russian, even though both use Cyrillic, so each is translated with the right language model. Formal closings such as "З повагою" become the usual sign-off in your language.

sv.subject: Information about the planning day
body: Hi to all parents and guardians,
On Friday, January 16, the preschool is closed for a planning day. If you need childcare that day, let us know by January 9.
Please also remember to label the children's winter clothes with their names.

Kind regards,
The staff at Solrosen
sv.note: Swedish emails are usually informal, starting with "Hej" even from schools and employers. Words like vårdnadshavare (parent or guardian) are translated into the everyday term in your language.

da.subject: Notice of the residents' meeting
body: Dear residents,
You are hereby invited to the ordinary residents' meeting on Wednesday, January 21 at 7 p.m. in the community house.
The agenda includes next year's budget and the renovation of the playground. Proposals must reach the board no later than one week before the meeting.

Kind regards,
The residents' board
da.note: Danish emails from housing associations, schools and employers mix formal notices with a friendly tone. Mailkin translates them in full, including times written as kl. 19.00.

no.subject: Appointment reminder
body: Hi,
This is a reminder that you have a dentist appointment on Tuesday, January 13 at 8:15 a.m.
If you can't attend, the appointment must be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance. Otherwise you will be invoiced for it.

Kind regards,
Tannlegesenteret Sentrum
no.note: Mailkin translates Norwegian written in Bokmål, the form used in most emails from businesses, schools and public services. The informal "Hei" and "Vennlig hilsen" become the usual greeting and sign-off in your language.

fi.subject: Water outage on Tuesday
body: Dear resident,
There will be a water outage in the building on Tuesday 20 January from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. because of pipe renovation. Please store some water in advance if needed.
Sauna bookings are cancelled on the same day. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Kind regards,
Property manager
fi.note: Finnish is famously hard for other speakers, with long inflected words and dates like 20.1. Mailkin translates notices from housing companies, schools and employers into plain language you can act on.

he.subject: Renewal of the rental contract
body: Hello,
The rental contract for the apartment ends at the end of February. The landlord would like to renew it for another year on the same terms.
We would be glad to receive your answer by January 15 so that we can prepare the documents.

Best regards,
Carmel Real Estate office
he.note: Hebrew is written right to left and usually without vowel marks. Mailkin translates the text into your language while Mail keeps the email's layout, so contracts and appointments are easy to follow.

hi.subject: Details of your Jaipur trip
body: Hello,
Your booking for the Jaipur trip is confirmed. Your driver will pick you up from the hotel on February 5 at 9 a.m.
Please keep your ID with you and let us know a day in advance about any changes.

Thank you,
Yatra Mitra Tours
hi.note: Mailkin translates Hindi written in Devanagari script. Emails that mix Hindi and English, common in India, are detected by their main language.

id.subject: Villa booking confirmation
body: Hello,
Thank you for your booking. We have the two-bedroom villa ready for you from March 3 to 8.
We can also arrange an airport pickup for an extra charge. Please reply to this email if you need it.

Warm regards,
The Villa Sawah Indah team
id.note: Indonesian emails from hotels, suppliers and partners often use the polite address Bapak/Ibu (Sir/Madam). Mailkin translates them naturally, and keeps dates and prices as written.

ms.subject: Your application documents
body: Greetings,
We have received your application for the bachelor's programme. However, the copy of your academic certificates is incomplete.
Please send these documents before January 30 so that your application can be processed.

Thank you.
Admissions Office
ms.note: Mailkin translates Malay as used in Malaysia, Brunei and Singapore. Formal phrases such as "Salam sejahtera" and "Sekian, terima kasih" become the usual greeting and closing in your language.

th.subject: Booking confirmation
body: Dear guest,
The resort confirms your booking of a sea-view room from February 10 to 14. Check-in is from 2 p.m.
If you need an airport transfer, please let us know your flight time at least one day in advance.

Respectfully,
Reception
th.note: Thai is written without spaces between words, which makes copy-and-paste translation messy. Mailkin translates the whole email in place, including times written as 14.00 น.

vi.subject: Product samples sent
body: Dear customer,
We sent three wooden chair samples by express courier this morning. They should arrive in about 5 working days.
Once you have checked the samples, please give us your feedback so we can prepare the official order.

Best regards,
Sales department
vi.note: Vietnamese emails from factories and suppliers use formal address such as "Kính gửi Quý khách" (Dear valued customer). Mailkin keeps the tone polite and the details, like quantities and delivery times, clear.
